record.name: LUKSO
record.description: Between November 17 and 18, 2026, an attacker exploited a security vulnerability in the backend of LUKSO's email-based Universal Profile recovery service, gaining unauthorized control over approximately 300 user accounts. The attacker abused the recovery service's permissions to add a malicious controller key to affected profiles and withdraw approximately 1.4 million LYX. The stolen tokens were subsequently bridged to Ethereum and exchanged for approximately 50 ETH ($95,000). LUKSO disabled the compromised recovery service, confirmed that its blockchain and Universal Profile smart contracts were unaffected, and began developing a reimbursement solution for affected users

reason: Discovered from the exploit feed, but no Bitget perpetual maps to the protocol or its chain, so there is nothing to trade.
nextStep: Capture the exploit transaction receipt to escalate from MONITOR to a full causal investigation.
